author: Linda Goins Fox
text: I get mine thru Medicare and my cost share they Tricare for Life, I get a 3 months supply. I don’t use the reader I use my IPhone. I am on insulin 5 times a day. I’m Type 1 & 2.

author: Barbara Conway Hala
text: The need for insulin is key for reimbursement by Medicare. T2 diabetics not needing insulin can’t get long term coverage of CGMs.
